notes:
- Company: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary product is in-app product intelligence and guided insights.
- Trial path: started with Hosted API for 2 weeks to validate integration and output quality; now moving to Dedicated evaluation for predictable latency and unit-cost.
- Quoted goals: avg latency < 350ms for short-chat turns (<= 256 tokens), p95 < 800ms for mixed-length responses. Throughput target: baseline 12 QPS, expected peak 75 QPS during weekly digest runs. Concurrency target: typically 10-25 simultaneous sessions, spikes to ~120 during scheduled digest jobs.
- Token mix observed in Hosted trial (sample week): avg tokens per request = 420 (prompt 180, completion 240). Traffic split: chat 55%, embeddings (semantic search) 30%, reranking 10%, batch summarization 5%.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high. Wants to see 30-40% unit-cost decrease from Hosted to Dedicated after batching + KV caching. Interested in quantization recommendations (int8/int4) for embeddings workloads.
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified variants (Llama2-chat or Flax-based opt), fallback to smaller family for low-cost routes. Ask: supported quantized model candidate list + expected perf on A10/V100/NVIDIA H100.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, option for data residency in US. Procurement will require SOC2 artifact and short security FAQ.
- POC ask: 3-month Dedicated POC with 2 reserved GPUs + autoscale policy (burst to 4), traffic-shaping rules, and canary routing. Need pricing for committed baseline and per-token overage.
- Sizing lead: provided hosted trial logs CSV. Need Redwood sizing workbook to be completed (QPS by endpoint, token histograms, expected concurrency windows).
- Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "We need predictable tails — 99th percentile is what's killing the UX, if you can show consistent p99 under 1s we'll move forward."
- Internal champion: Head of Product (Elena Park). Procurement lead: Ryan Cho.
- Notes on integration: currently using SDK (Python), prefix caching implemented client-side. Looking to test server-side prefix/KV caching effectiveness.
- Action items: SE to produce sizing workbook + recommended GPU profile; infra to propose autoscale & cache config; Marcus to draft POC pricing.
use_case_summary: Live in-app assistant (multi-turn) + semantic search for product analytics. Mix of low-latency chat for interactive sessions and batch/embedding pipelines for nightly refreshes. Need predictable latency at scale and lower cost/ token via batching/quantization. Requires SSO, audit logs, and US data residency option.
capacity_forecast_notes: Observed hosted trial: avg QPS 10-14; baseline planning: 12 QPS sustained
Peak forecasts: 60-80 QPS for hourly digest and campaign runs (10-12 minute window)
Concurrency: normal 10-25 concurrent chat sessions; peak 100-130 when scheduled jobs overlap
Token mix assumptions for sizing workbook: 60% short-turn chats (<256 tokens), 30% med-length (256-1024), 10% long summarization (>1024)
Embeddings pipeline: 30% of traffic but heavy on vector ops—batching expected to reduce cost by 3-5x for nightly bulk embedding run
Suggested dedicated baseline: 2x A10 or 1x H100 (eval perf) with autoscale to 4 GPUs for peaks; test batch size knobs and dynamic batching TTL for KV cache hits
Expected throughput per A10 (estimate from SE): ~20-25 chat QPS for 256-token context at target latency; H100 increases throughput and reduces p99 by ~35% but at higher infra cost
Token-per-second budgeting: assume 12 QPS * avg 420 tokens => ~5,040 tokens/sec baseline (service-level key for rate-limiting and cost projections)
Reserve recommendation: 20% headroom above forecasted peak for safe SLA margin during POC
